body.intent: Make Mistral Vibe a first-class CliProvider client using one shared plain-CLI execution adapter for backend requests and VS Code plugin chat, removing the vibe-app-server transport entirely while preserving plugin streaming. Model, effort, prompt transport, safety handling and the exact MCP tool naming are aligned by construction and qualified against the installed Vibe 3.1.4 (headless --model/--thinking, --approval-policy, custom agents, --enabled-tools, budget guards, --output-dir export evidence — live-confirmed 2026-11-24). Narrowly authorized insrc analysis tools are enabled in read-only sessions only when live qualification proves the no-blanket-bypass invariant; otherwise the session fails closed and analysis stays unavailable (ISSUE-d3e72fe73ee775a2). Hand-written TOML parsing is replaced with smol-toml across all identified daemon and plugin Vibe paths (ISSUE-0b3114f87754959b). The overlapping issue set is verified and reconciled: confirm the apparent prompt-transport fix (ISSUE-910fce32967bc4ea), identify remaining catalog gaps, and record the review-dependent issues as deferred pending the review rewrite.
nonGoals: Retain vibe-app-server as a backend transport or verification layer.
Allow blanket permission bypass to enable read-only analysis tools.
Restore removed review-activity or streaming-review machinery; review integration awaits the review rewrite.
Plain CLI with temporary app-server fallback
Share launch rules; preserve chat UX
Replace parsing only where the adapter needs it
Defer TOML cleanup to separate tracked work
body.scopeBoundary: The overhaul stops at the Vibe execution/config surfaces: the shared adapter replaces the backend CliProvider vibe paths and the plugin chat launch path, and the smol-toml replacement covers only the identified Vibe TOML paths (plugin MCP config writer, daemon registration checks, shared inline-list interpretation) with surgical edits that preserve unrelated user configuration. Review integration is out of scope until the review rewrite establishes its replacement (ISSUE-30962d0f44df1e76 and the review portion of ISSUE-738d62b848fd173f are recorded as deferred dependencies on it; 738d62b8's surviving catalog-coverage sub-point is verified within this scope). Read-only analysis authorization ships only on successful qualification — never via a blanket bypass. Issues close only with supporting evidence; no speculative closures.
body.title: Unify Vibe on one plain-CLI execution adapter
